sentences.text: This young {sex} southern elephant seal, a {stage}, was tagged at {release_site} and tracked for {days_tracked}.
At sea, elephant seals dive almost continuously, spending only minutes at the surface between dives.
His deepest recorded dive went to {deepest_dive_m}, and his longest lasted {longest_dive_min}.
On {farthest_date} he was {max_displacement_km} from where tracking began, and his track reached {southernmost_lat}.
